projects.description: Case studies across business websites, product interfaces, and custom web applications — built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.

1.title: AG Gradnja – Construction Company Website
1.valueProposition: A multilingual business website built to present construction services clearly and convert visitors into clients.
1.paragraph: A multilingual business website built to present construction services clearly and convert visitors into clients.
1.challenge: The company needed a professional online presence that could communicate credibility across markets, showcase completed work, and perform well for local and international search traffic.
1.solution: Designed and developed a production website in Next.js with a clean service structure, project gallery, multilingual support (SR, EN, DE, TR, AR), image optimization, and SEO-ready page architecture.
1.outcome: A fast, scalable marketing site that strengthens brand trust and gives AG Gradnja a clear digital foundation for growth.
keyFeatures: Multilingual site structure (SR, EN, DE, TR, AR)
Responsive layouts for mobile and desktop
1.paragraph2: Built for real-world production use with responsive layouts, clear information architecture, and performance-focused frontend patterns that keep the experience sharp on every device.
1.seoTitle: AG Gradnja Construction Website | Next.js Multilingual Business Site
1.seoDescription: Case study: multilingual Next.js website for AG Gradnja — construction services, project showcase, SEO, and conversion-focused UX by Mehmed Muric.
1.imageAlt: AG Gradnja construction company website screenshot

2.title: GPT-3 Inspired AI Landing Page
2.valueProposition: A conversion-oriented AI product landing page inspired by modern SaaS marketing experiences.
2.paragraph: A conversion-oriented AI product landing page inspired by modern SaaS marketing experiences.
2.challenge: AI products often struggle to explain complex capabilities in a way that feels clear, trustworthy, and visually memorable on first visit.
2.solution: Built a responsive React landing page with structured storytelling sections, strong visual hierarchy, and UI patterns commonly used by modern AI SaaS brands.
2.outcome: A polished frontend showcase that demonstrates product storytelling, layout craft, and marketing-ready UI engineering.
keyFeatures: Strong visual hierarchy for product value
2.paragraph2: Focused on content structure, visual rhythm, and responsive behavior so the page communicates product value quickly across desktop and mobile.
2.seoTitle: GPT-3 Inspired AI Landing Page Development | Next.js & React Project
2.seoDescription: Case study: GPT-3 inspired AI landing page built with React — modern SaaS UI, responsive design, and conversion-focused layout by Mehmed Muric.
2.imageAlt: GPT-3 inspired AI landing page screenshot

3.title: Crypto Web3 Landing Experience
3.valueProposition: A Web3-inspired crypto landing experience focused on trust, clarity, and modern interaction patterns.
3.paragraph: A Web3-inspired crypto landing experience focused on trust, clarity, and modern interaction patterns.
3.challenge: Crypto products need to communicate security and usability without overwhelming users with technical complexity.
3.solution: Developed a React-based Web3 landing page with wallet-connect simulation, market-oriented sections, and a UI designed around reliability and fast interactions.
3.outcome: A frontend case study that shows how to present blockchain products with clearer UX and stronger visual confidence.
3.paragraph2: Sections cover reliability, security messaging, transaction flow concepts, and responsive presentation for crypto-focused audiences.
3.seoTitle: Crypto Web3 Landing Page | React Blockchain UI Project
3.seoDescription: Case study: Web3 crypto landing page with wallet-connect simulation, modern React UI, and trust-focused UX by Mehmed Muric.

4.title: Restaurant Landing Page
4.valueProposition: An elegant restaurant website designed to showcase dining experience and drive reservations.
4.paragraph: An elegant restaurant website designed to showcase dining experience and drive reservations.
4.challenge: Restaurants need a digital presence that feels inviting, presents the menu clearly, and makes booking the next step obvious.
4.solution: Created a modern React and Tailwind landing page with menu highlights, service sections, testimonials, and a clear reservation-focused call to action.
4.outcome: A refined hospitality website that balances atmosphere, usability, and conversion across devices.
4.paragraph2: The layout prioritizes food presentation, navigation clarity, and mobile-friendly browsing for guests discovering the restaurant online.
4.seoTitle: Restaurant Landing Page Development | React & Tailwind Project
4.seoDescription: Case study: modern restaurant landing page with menu highlights, reservation CTA, and responsive React UI by Mehmed Muric.

5.title: Fintech Payment Landing Page
5.valueProposition: A fintech product page built to communicate trust, clarity, and modern payment capabilities.
5.paragraph: A fintech product page built to communicate trust, clarity, and modern payment capabilities.
5.challenge: Financial products must feel secure and easy to understand while still looking premium enough to earn user confidence.
5.solution: Designed and engineered a React landing page highlighting digital payments, billing control, rewards, and customer proof points with a clean, trust-forward UI.
5.outcome: A professional fintech marketing surface that demonstrates strong UI engineering for trust-sensitive products.
5.paragraph2: Includes product features, customer statistics, billing messaging, testimonials, and partner presentation in a responsive layout.
5.seoTitle: Fintech Payment Landing Page | React UI Case Study
5.seoDescription: Case study: fintech payment solutions landing page with trust-focused UI, feature storytelling, and responsive React design by Mehmed Muric.

6.title: Ecommerce Shop with Vite + React
6.valueProposition: A fast ecommerce storefront focused on product discovery, cart flow, and responsive shopping UX.
6.paragraph: A fast ecommerce storefront focused on product discovery, cart flow, and responsive shopping UX.
6.challenge: Online shops need smooth browsing and cart interactions without sacrificing speed or clarity on mobile.
6.solution: Built a Vite + React ecommerce application with a dynamic product catalog, add-to-cart system, checkout flow, and a clean UI optimized for everyday shopping tasks.
6.outcome: A modular storefront foundation that shows practical ecommerce UX and performant frontend architecture.
6.paragraph2: Developed with a modular workflow so product listing, cart state, and responsive layout stay maintainable as the catalog grows.
6.seoTitle: Ecommerce Shop Development with Vite + React | Case Study
6.seoDescription: Case study: Vite + React ecommerce shop with product catalog, cart flow, checkout UX, and responsive frontend architecture by Mehmed Muric.

hero.title: Full-Stack Developer building modern digital products
paragraphs: I'm Mehmed Muric — building reliable, scalable apps with modern frontend, solid backend architecture, and clear UX.
